title: Electrospray Ionization Mass Spectrometry Insights into the Assembly of Lanthanide-Containing Clusters
claim: Repeated small motifs, including lanthanide cubanes and octahedral lanthanide units, recur within some higher-nuclearity cluster structures.
explanation: Vertex-sharing cubane motifs can yield cyclic or spherical structures, and octahedral motifs also appear in assembled structures.
scope: Structural descriptions of selected high-nuclearity lanthanide-containing clusters.
caveats: A repeated motif in a final crystal structure does not by itself establish that the same motif was the actual solution-phase construction unit.
